artifact: BUG-117 stage-entry control repair approval design
status: read-only design recommendation; no repair approval or implementation authorization

proposed_production_scope.edit_point: after the existing INITIAL_ENTRY_STATE guard and before JOY_DIR, PLAYER_WANT, PLAYER_FACE, or PLAYER_MANUAL are written
proposed_production_scope.logic: Use B to OR PLAYER_MANUAL with PLAYER_DIR; when the result is zero, return through rj_done without publishing the computed direction. Otherwise keep the current A value and execute existing admission stores.
proposed_production_scope.state_invariant: init_player sets PLAYER_MANUAL=0 and PLAYER_DIR=DIR_NORTH=0. The automatic entrance remains north-directed until pt_at_center recognizes cell (12,18) and clears PLAYER_DIR to DIR_NONE. The first admitted manual request sets PLAYER_MANUAL=1, which remains latched until init_player. The input tests do not overwrite A, so the resolved direction remains intact.

observed.classification: qualified positional divergence; first stage2 scheduled movement was suppressed by early manual ownership

source_evidence.finding: rj_request first honors INITIAL_ENTRY_STATE, then publishes the resolved A direction to JOY_DIR, PLAYER_WANT and PLAYER_FACE and latches PLAYER_MANUAL. JOY_DIR is cleared earlier by read_joystick; the proposed block retains neutral direction while preserving raw axis samples.
init_player establishes cell (12,22), north direction 0, step 0, manual 0, and framebuffer $89EC. next_stage calls init_player before presenting the next-stage level map.

The automatic north path advances the framebuffer by -320 per scheduled step. At center cell (12,18), pt_at_center clears PLAYER_DIR and PLAYER_WANT to $FF before normal joystick sampling resumes. The arrival step itself reaches y=18/step=0; a following no-movement center call clears direction.

The nonadaptive main loop samples joystick after player_tick; adaptive_active samples before its bounded simulation batch and also calls read_joystick while presentation is retained. The proposed guard is therefore evaluated in both orderings. The INITIAL_ENTRY_STATE barrier and its marker/music sequence remain unchanged.

The adaptive foreground input path calls read_joystick outside MODE_DEMO, including retained presentation modes. A MODE_NORMAL-only guard would therefore admit the held request during MODE_LEVEL preview and is rejected.

Name-entry initialization sets PLAYER_DIR to DIR_NONE before name_tick reads joystick. Its first non-neutral request passes the proposed OR guard and latches PLAYER_MANUAL=1; subsequent north input also passes.
The alternate ranking/name path likewise initializes PLAYER_DIR to DIR_NONE before its joystick read.

The relevant manual-flag writers clear it at init_player and set it on directional admission or at demo alignment; demo direction is separately owned, and main skips resident joystick reads in MODE_DEMO.

PRES_SCREEN is presentation-map state. Start/menu input is handled through PRES_EVENT and MENU_SCAN; the proposed guard is confined to resident directional admission and does not change that raw menu path.

capacity_projection.source: Parent-provided BUG-120 Ready fit baseline; values are resident free bytes, not a new build measurement.
capacity_projection.qualification: projection only; assembler map and every shipped profile must confirm fit after explicit repair approval

rejected_options.reason: The source projection leaves 20 bytes free in the tightest 42-byte profile, 12 below the required 32-byte minimum.
It fails the required preview boundary: the adaptive path samples joystick input while MODE_LEVEL is retained, so a MODE_NORMAL-only filter does not protect the held input before release.

rejected_options.option: Reuse ENTRY_MAZE_ENTRY or wait on AUDIO_MUSIC_PUBLISHED_BUSY
rejected_options.reason: That couples stage preview placement to the existing life-entry/audio handoff, adds lifecycle behavior and waits, and is outside the authorized repair scope.

approval_card_outline.purpose_and_risk: Prevent directional requests from taking manual ownership while PLAYER_DIR=DIR_NORTH and PLAYER_MANUAL=0 identify the source-proven automatic entrance. Distinct risk: input ownership leaks during a retained stage preview and blocks scheduled placement.
approval_card_outline.automated_target: With the frozen approved predecessor and an actually sampled held Down request, the first scheduled north step must match neutral position: entry (12,22)/$89EC/step0; first result (12,22)/$88AC/step1; PLAYER_MANUAL remains 0 and no held direction is published before placement. Facing is not the oracle. Keep the existing first-result stop and phase/deadline limits.
approval_card_outline.source_liveness_target: At the authored placement (12,18)/$75EC/step0, the existing center branch clears north direction without translating the player. The next normal joystick sample can admit the held request; the first directional request then latches manual ownership. Verify the bounded one-center-tick release behavior and do not permit any extra position step.
negative_controls: A manually owned north-moving state (PLAYER_MANUAL nonzero) must continue through existing input admission.
Name-entry state starts with PLAYER_DIR=DIR_NONE; its first directional request must pass, latch manual, and subsequent north requests must remain admitted.
A missing sampled Down or missing/duplicate first scheduled result is setup or missing coverage, never a pass.
approval_card_outline.commands_and_limits: Reuse the already approved scheduled-step observer, frozen capsule, two neutral/held cases, 45-second whole-phase ceilings, 10-second stop ceiling, 1000 callbacks per phase and 270-second aggregate upper bound. Exact candidate-build commands and map-fit checks belong in the assignment after repair approval; no runtime command was executed for this design review.
approval_card_outline.manual_split: This focused observer does not replace the existing BUG-117 manual life/death checklist or establish ticket completion.

open_approval_point: The compact guard intentionally keeps control neutral through the target arrival pose and reopens on the next normal center call, which clears PLAYER_DIR without moving the sprite. Approval should accept that bounded no-movement tick; otherwise the one-file/6-byte proposal does not establish same-sample release and requires a revised fit-safe design before implementation.
